alex: Hey — hunting raw request lines for trace_id=4a1b2c3d4e and request_id=8a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-0123456789ab. Console Traces shows spans but Console Logs returns nothing. Anyone have quick steps? Need full request payload for a customer repro.

marta: Start in Console Logs -> top search box. Try: request_id:"8a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-0123456789ab"  or jsonPayload.request_id="8a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-0123456789ab". Console collapses fields so click 'Show raw' on a log line. If still nothing, jump to Traces -> paste trace_id -> open spans -> look for tag http.request_id.

sam: CLI quick path if console is hiding stuff:

```
# stream recent logs and filter client-side
rb-stern -n prod "app=edge-proxy" --since 1h | jq -c 'select(.request_id=="8a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-0123456789ab")'
# Redwood CLI (if available)
redwood logs tail --req-id 8a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-0123456789ab --env prod --since 1h
```

sam: If you suspect the header got lost between LB and pod, also check kubectl logs for the sidecars (envoy/nginx) on the path.

priya: Another fallback: edge access logs in S3. Path: s3://redwood-edge-logs/prod/YYYY/MM/DD/*.gz. You can run:

```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-edge-logs/prod/2024/08/15/edge-logs-2024-08-15.gz - | zgrep "8a1b2c3d-4e5f" | head
```

priya: For trace->req correlation: open Traces, click a span, then 'View attributes' — there's often an attribute like request_id or http.request_id. If not, search spans for 'x-request-id' header name. Also check span links to the service that emits access logs (edge-proxy).

alex: Thanks — quick Q: some requests show trace but no x-request-id header. Should we alert when header missing? It's happening ~2% prod traffic.

marta: Yeah that's usually from clients that don't set x-request-id or from the CDN rewriting it. Quick check: look at ingress config in deploy repo (infra/ingress/nginx.conf) — we add X-Request-Id if missing via `proxy_set_header X-Request-Id $request_id;` so it should always exist. If missing, check CDN -> LB chain.

priya: Filed a tiny alert suggestion: make an anomaly rule on dashboard 'edge.request_id_missing_ratio' > 0.005 for 10m. Playbook with steps: https://redwood.internal/docs/obs/find-request-logs (internal)

log-bot: logs-indexer: raw lines for 8a1b2c3d-4e5f... were indexed 45s ago in index 'prod-edge-raw'

alex: Great — I'll try the rb-stern + S3 check and post back. :thumbsup:
